backlog_item.title: Включить логирование исходящих запросов WB после release review
backlog_item.business_meaning: Для разбора интеграционных сбоев нужно видеть, какой метод Wildberries вызывался, по какому адресу и с каким статусом завершился, но текущих безопасных данных для диагностики не хватает. При этом обычное логирование может случайно записать токен, код маркировки или другие чувствительные значения и создать новую проблему. После ревью нужно включить структурированный журнал только с разрешёнными полями, доказать маскирование секретов и дать инженеру понятный способ найти конкретный запрос; отдельное разрешение владельца на release всё равно обязательно.

blocker.details: S04 RESEARCH_REWORK: S03 does not close the safe WB logging contract. It must (1) make zero raw WB response body/path/object-id leakage mandatory across every API and worker handler/sink, including log_wb_client_error, rather than allowing the legacy lane to remain outside the structured event; (2) cover current WB auth modes and secrets beyond Authorization, including service/basic-token X-Client-Secret and token-type 401/403 constraints, without reading or changing credentials; (3) assess omitted WB statuses, at minimum 402 on current FBS endpoints and applicability of 406/451; (4) specify rate-limit parsing/proof for token-type aggregation and absent/malformed headers, including X-Ratelimit-Remaining absent on 429 and numeric Retry/Limit/Reset; (5) replace LIVE_SANDBOX not-applicable with the official content/marketplace/supplies sandbox hosts, test-token constraints and lower-limit differences, while keeping deterministic emulator/MockTransport proof and prohibiting live calls.

resume_condition.condition: Revise the S03 dossier and capability matrix with official WB 2026 auth, error/status, rate-limit and sandbox sources; make end-to-end API+worker leak tests and emulator/sandbox host classification explicit; then resume S04 for independent re-review.

rules: Read AGENTS.md, docs/process/PIPELINE-RU.md and pipeline/pipeline.yml first.
Do not accept your own work.
If status is WAITING, do not advance; report the blocker and wait for resume.
If budget_enforced is true, advance requires usage receipt fields.
If blocked_by is non-empty, do not pass the blocker resume stage without resolve-blocker evidence.
Use python3 scripts/pipeline/run.py advance only for the stage you own.
Do not set DONE while pipeline status is not ACTIVE.
